author: gpt
statement: For every n >= 20,700, every 2-colouring of 1..n with M <= M(C_n) agrees with C_n, in the nearer of the two colour orientations, outside the eleven windows (b_i - 75, b_i + 75].
quote: For every n≥20,700 any colouring with M≤M(C_n), after choosing the nearer of the two colour orientations, agrees with C_n outside the eleven (b_i−75,b_i+75] windows.
